decoder.token_budget: unchanged production estimator budget (950 on this cohort)

concurrency: One model at a time, four cases in independent Python processes sharing one local model and four 4096-token slots.

transport_interruptions.stage: production correction after primary reached 950 tokens
transport_interruptions.outcome: No response. The server process received SIGKILL and closed the socket before the client could read an HTTP status or model output. Exact failed-attempt duration was unmeasured; the incident occurred within this interval.
transport_interruptions.recovery: Only the missing correction was reissued after restarting the original engine with the same GGUF, flags and pinned benchmark revision f95f54e9abfbe45329fd1f604470445937965e92. The primary receipt was restored from its checkpoint. The failed transport is excluded from the model-response count and wall_model_seconds.
